summary: iteration_81: Regression + functional testing of backlog batch (b) Admin Chat Prompt editor, (b2) chat-with-override, (c) Dürt/Nudge, (d) İş Kolu searchable combobox, (e) category reporting, (f) desktop push+sound. All backend tests pass (8/8) and all frontend flows work end-to-end against the preview URL as admin (serkan). No error boundary was triggered anywhere. Chat prompt correctly reset to empty at end.
action_items: MINOR / SPEC-ONLY: Review-request says 'İŞ KOLU PERFORMANSI' grid lives inside Tasks panel > team scope; in the actual code the grid is rendered by TeamPanel.jsx (own tab). Feature works — category-card-* elements render there with counts from GET /api/team/category-summary. Only a documentation mismatch, no functional bug.

MINOR: notification-pref-enable/sound toggles are not rendered when the browser has denied OS notification permission (test harness case). This is expected UX but could be reworded — currently the panel only shows an 'İzin reddedildi' explainer. Consider surfacing the sound toggle regardless (sound doesn't need OS permission).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/tasks_router.py is >1500 LOC now — Nudge, Lock/OTP, Share, Category endpoints could reasonably be split into separate submodules.

GET/PUT /api/admin/chat-prompt trims whitespace on save; if user copies a multi-line prompt with leading spaces they'll be discarded silently — consider preserving inner whitespace and only .strip()'ing outer whitespace (current .strip() only affects leading/trailing which is fine, but worth documenting).

team_service.notify_task_nudge stores payload.task_id and leaves task_id=None to bypass the (user,task,type) dedup index — this is intentional and correctly documented in code. Ensure any future compaction job that groups notifications by task_id also inspects payload.task_id to avoid orphaning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional on (b), (c), (d), (f); (e) verified in TeamPanel via prior iterations

test_credentials: serkan / 19071987 (admin), mgr_test / mgr12345 (manager Test Company A), emp1_test / emp12345 (employee Test Company A). Login response key is `token` (NOT `access_token`).
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data. Test tasks created inside each test function were cleaned up in try/finally (DELETE /api/tasks/{id}). Chat prompt was reset to empty (tr='' en='') at the end of test suite AND at the end of UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend login endpoint returns `{token, token_type, user}` — token key is `token`, not `access_token`. Notifications endpoint (/api/notifications) returns a top-level JSON list (not {items:[]}). Chat POST /api/chat returns {conversation_id, user_message, assistant_message:{content}, sources[]} — assistant text is at j['assistant_message']['content']. UI login button text is 'GİRİŞ YAP' (has-text 'YAP' works). OverdueAlertModal appears after login as data-testid=overdue-alert-close — always dismiss first. task-category-select is a BUTTON element (searchable combobox), not native SELECT. In team scope of TasksPanel there are 38 nudge buttons on the test dataset — clicking one produces toast 'Hatırlatma gönderildi'. Category reporting cards (category-card-*) live in TeamPanel.jsx, NOT TasksPanel. notification-pref-enable/sound toggles are only rendered when the browser has NOT denied OS notification permission; on the test harness browser they may be absent (expected).
rca of the issue: N/A — no reproduced bugs. All requested features functional; only two spec/implementation observations documented under action_items (both cosmetic, no code change required).
